sections.markdown:
## C2 — Turning, cyclist and motorcycle confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A23
A right turn from a four-lane highway starts in the right lane and ends tight in the cross street's right lane, while a left turn starts from the inside lane nearest the center line. [A23]
Why it matters: group_hint turn-lane-choice; prereq_hint sec04-F08; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F13, sec04-F14.
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A23
Turn signals go on at least 100 feet before the turn and kept on until you turn, and then must be switched off once the maneuver is complete. [A23]
Why it matters: group_hint signaling; prereq_hint sec04-F08; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F09, sec04-F11.
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A23
Signal lights are the standard turn signal, and hand and arm signals are an addition for daylight when sunlight can wash out the light, not a replacement. [A23]
Why it matters: group_hint signaling; prereq_hint sec04-F09; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F12.
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A25
Three-point turns are prohibited where oncoming drivers within 500 feet cannot see you, even when no sign forbids the turn. [A25]
Why it matters: group_hint three-point-turn; prereq_hint sec04-F15; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec04-F16, sec04-F17.
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A25
Cyclists normally keep as far right as practicable, yet they may also ride two abreast at all times and move left to pass, to turn left, or to avoid hazards. [A25]
Why it matters: group_hint cyclist-position; prereq_hint sec04-F19; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec04-F20, sec04-F21.
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A26
Drivers stay out of bicycle lanes except to park, enter or leave the highway, or prepare a turn, and for a turn across the lane they move into it first when it is safe. [A26]
Why it matters: group_hint bicycle-lane; prereq_hint sec04-F23; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec04-F25, sec04-F26.
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A26
The bicycle helmet rule applies to riders under 16, while the three-foot passing clearance applies to every driver passing any cyclist. [A26]
Why it matters: group_hint bicycle-law; prereq_hint sec04-F19; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F24, sec04-F27.
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A28
Behind a motorcycle the normal gap is the same 2 seconds as behind a car, but in darkness, rain or on slippery roads the gap should be longer. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint motorcycle-following; prereq_hint sec04-F34; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F37, sec04-F39.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A28
A motorcyclist changing position within the lane is still using a full lane, so a car may never share that lane even when the rider is far to one side. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint motorcycle-lane; prereq_hint sec04-F33; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F38.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A27
Seeing a motorcycle is not enough before a left turn, because drivers also misjudge its distance and speed, so look again and know its speed first. [A27]
Why it matters: group_hint motorcycle-left-turn; prereq_hint sec04-F34; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F35, sec04-F36.
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0027]
